title: Issues mod.json
description: What Herdr reads from the Issues mod's mod.json, and the settings it takes.

title.description: The mod's name, as Herdr shows it.

place.description: Where Herdr first docks the mod.

mentions.title: Issues in this terminal
mentions.description: Read the focused terminal every 10 seconds for #123 and links to the repository's issues, and list them under "In this terminal". Off, the terminal is never read.

worktrees_root.title: Worktrees folder
worktrees_root.description: Where Start agent puts the worktree of an issue, as <folder>/<owner>-<repo>/<branch>. A leading ~ is your home folder. Use the same folder as Branch PR to keep both mods' worktrees together.

font_size.title: Font size
font_size.description: Size of this mod's main text in px; smaller and larger text keep their proportion to it.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Scales this mod's icons, buttons and row heights. 1 is Herdr's own size.
